rows.TEXT:
Prusheen 
"The Dwarvesss have been tricked. They are carrying out her plansss now. But the Elvesss have a messsiah who is sssaid to hear Gallean's voice and even sssense the future. Mortisss has need of this...avatar. Ssseeek him..."

Sheggrah 
"What wasss that? Look! We are being watched..."

Grumdull 
"Quick, lass! Take us from this place! We must get word back to the Queen!"

Sheggrah 
"The plan hasss failed! The Dwarvesss will no longer complete the ceremony!"

Sheggrah 
"Quickly, Dessstroy the Valkyrie! Shhhe must not live!"

Grumdull 
"Wotan forgive me m'lady. I have failed to protect you. I die by your side..."

Lachla'an 
"Strange...I foresaw a great amount of death approaching, but I had not seen Mortis as the source..."

Gulmuskae 
"Your visions did not deceive you, Elf. You'll not die at Mortis' hands! Hahahah!"

Lachla'an 
"Father! Why have you allowed this? Aaaaaagh..."

Sheggrah 
"Foolsss! Mortisss wished usss to destroy the Elf! You shall be punished!"

Wraith Prusheen 
"Mortisss does not care. She only wishhhed Lachla'an's death. But we must recover hisss remainsss to appeassse her."

Sheggrah 
"Quickly then! In a rage, the demonsss tore Lachla'an apart. We musst recover hisss divided pieces from the three beasssts."
Collect the separated portions of Lachla'an's body from the demons Gulmuskae, Kremnimus, and Esremerios.

Esremerios 
"Corpses! Once Mortis is finished using you, you'll be joining Bethrezen in Hell!"

Wraith Prusheen 
"We have recovered Lachla'an's head. We mussst keep it until Mortisss reveals its use."

Kremnimus 
"Take the dead flesh, vultures. It will not save you from Bethrezen's plague."

Wraith Prusheen 
"Yesss, we have recovered Lachla'an's body. Mortisss will be mossst pleasssed."

Gulmuskae 
"The heart still beats...why? Destroy it, as you have destroyed me..."

Wraith Prusheen 
"Ahhh...Lachla'an's heart. How disssgustingly pure it isss. The creature wasss right, it still beatsss."

Wraith Prusheen 
"Mortisss has revealed her plansss, and sooo the ceremony beginsss. Bring the Elf remnantsss to the circle..."

Warlock 
"They are here, Prusheen. But the demons were not...careful...with the body. We will need to find replacements for some of the limbs."

Wraith Prusheen 
"We have a sssoul who will donate to our caussse. Use what you will, dissspose of the ressst."

Elf Lord 
"No! Lachla'an! My messiah - fallen. You monste...uuuuuugh!"

Warlock 
"The ritual begins! It will be but a moment, Prusheen...there...it is done."

Dark Elf Lachla'an 
"I...live! The pain! Mother...help me stop the pain!"

Sheggrah 
"Nith, have you located thisss Elf messsiah?"

Nith 
"I wasn't able to reach Lachla'an. I passed unnoticed through Greenskin territory and almost made it to the Elven habitations. I found giants, circling some sort of...sort of...I..."

Shegrrah 
"What are you rambling about? What isss it that you found?"

Nith 
"The giants are possessed by it, but they do not understand. It needs a sacrifice. It calls to me. Still it calls to me!"

Grave Golem 
...something up there...something unliving, like us...you can join us...we need you...

Nith 
"No! Back away! This is my release!"

Wraith Prusheen 
"Yesss...let him go. Mortisss wishesss thisss."

Nith 
"I understand...yes...grant me death and I grant you life...a fair trade. I escape you, Mortis! I escape you!"

Grave Golem 
...free...I return soon...I return to serve my mother...

Sheggrah 
"The heat sssinges my rotting flesh. Sssomething sssleeps in there...sssomething powerful..."

Sheggrah 
"This ruin isss covered in iccce. It will take sssome time to work our way in. Sssomething in there stirsss..."

Sheggrah 
"The ssserpentsss were guarding thisss orb. It isss a pity they did not know how to ussse it."

Wraith Prusheen 
"We've cleaned out the city, and yet no sssign of thisss messsiah. No Elf will ssspeak of his location, even when we ssslay their loved onesss."

Phantom Warrior 
"Who approachessss? Could it be that Crowley hasss sssent hisss judgesss back to usss for their own trial? Your victimsss are ready to judge you!"

Wraith Prusheen 
"These sssoulsss were too confusssed to join our army. They were the victimsss of the witch-hunter'sss unjust trialsss, mossst of them completely innocent. Thisss...Crowley...will make a fine sssoldier for Mortisss when he is ssslain."

Sheggrah 
"I sssense evidence of the Damned here. Again, why ssso clossse to the humansss?"

Sheggrah 
"The wind growsss unbearable here. Shapesss move in the center of the maelssstrom. What magic isss thisss?"

Sheggrah 
"I don't know what the elementalistsss were trying to accomplish, but their minionsss will no longer be a nuisssance to usss..."

Sheggrah 
"The power emanating from thisss blade isss magnificent...we mussst test it on living flesh."

Sheggrah 
"What manner of beassst wasss that?"

Wraith Prusheen 
"It wasss a manticore, a magical abomination. I did not realize there were ssstill conjurersss capable of sssumonning them."

Sheggrah 
"Thessse giantsss fought asss sssavagess, asss if they were mad. Whatever liesss at the bottom of that pool mussst have great power."

Sheggrah 
"The etchings on thisss crown warn that its wearer will lapssse into fitsss of rage when signsss of battle are near. It isss an ancient Dwarven artifact but we can ussse it against them."

Wraith Prusheen 
"How easssy the righteousss fall before usss. Mortisss is stronger than your faith."
I specialize in keeping your soldiers alive.

Wraith Prusheen 
"Ironic, isssn't it? Every Dwarf we ssslay strengthensss their will to complete our ceremony."
Yeah? Sure, I got one 'a those!
A meeting place for the skilled tradesmen of the land.
Feel free to browse our many stands, you're bound to find something.

Sheggrah 
"Thisss isssland wasss captured by Orc raidersss recently. It isss sssaid a fierce Orc king led the assault, no doubt he ssstill rulesss the city. We may find sssomething of use within the city'sss crumbled wallsss..."
Come on in, we have many bags full of wonderful items for you to look through.

Sheggrah 
"Jussst as I thought...the Orc King refusssed to part with hisss ssspoils of war. All the better for usss."
It don't look like much, but I've been through three wars and I can whip your army into shape.

Sheggrah 
"Thisss new sssect of the Empire fightsss with much more fanaticisssm than we've ever ssseen. They hurl themssselvesss at usss without ssstrategy."
Sure, I can teach you spells, but I offer no refund if your mundane mind cannot comprehend them.
We've spent centuries researching the secrets of magic, we can teach you as well...

Sheggrah 
"The Empire ssseemsss to be fighting itssself. It worksss in our favor; they will be too busssy to even realize what we are doing."
If you can afford it, we can turn your men into gods.

Wraith Prusheen 
"With Nith gone, we have no ssspy to keep an eye on the Dwarvessss..."

Silt 
"I understand, master. I will begin my duties right away. Expect a report soon."

Silt 
"Master, there have been complications with the Dwarven ceremony..."

Silt 
"It seems as though most of the Loremasters who could perform the ritual were slain or scattered during the war. They now seek the old ones who may remember the rites."

Wraith Prusheen 
"Very well, continue to watch them and report to usss if any progresss is made."
I can bring back the dead to fight for you.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
